title: Duals of algebraic matroids need not be algebraic
summary: We give an example showing that the dual of an algebraic matroid need not be algebraic. Our example is a matroid of rank 6 on 10 elements which is algebraic in characteristic 2. It is obtained by gluing an algebraic realization of the non-Fano matroid to a realization of the Fano matroid. Its dual is shown not to be algebraic using the Ingleton-Main lemma.
